tei:div.tei:p: le'u gsum pa/ rang don rjes dpag 1 shloka 111 dang 112 pa gnyis la rgya dper rkang pa brgyad 'dug kyang bod 'gyur rkang pa drug gsal/ 2 rgya dper shloka gnyis yod pa bod 'gyur tshig rkang dgur bsgyur 'dug 3 tshad ma grub ṭīka yi/ 4 tshad ma grub ṭīka bye brag 5 rgya dper tshig rkang 'di mi 'dug 6 tshad ma grub ṭīka de yi/ 7 bod 'gyur rtsa bar tshig rkang 'di mi gsal yang rgya dpe'i tshig ni/ eten byabh-icāṛtwamuktaṃ zhes pa bsgyur bkos byas/ 8 rgya dpe'i shloka gcig la bod 'gyur tshig rkang lngar bsgyur 'dug 9 rgya dper/ rim pa'ang med/ ces gsal/ 10 rgya dpe'i shloka gcig la bod 'gyur tshig rkang lngar bsgyur ba gsal/ 11 rgya dper rtsa 'grel tshig rkang 'di gnyis la ang grangs 'khod mi 'dug ste bod bsgyur tshig rkang gnyis po 'di la'ang tshigs bcad 341 pa'i tshul du ang grangs 'khod yod/ 12 rgya dper tshigs bcad 342 'di mi 'dug le'u bzhi pa/ gzhan don rjes dpag 1 sde dge yin/ 2 sde dge yin/ 3 rgya dper shloka gcig la bod 'gyur tshig rkang gsum du bsgyur 'dug 4 rgya dper/ de/ 5 sde dge med la/ 6 rgya dper shloka gcig la bod 'gyur tshig rkang lnga bsgyur 'dug
